tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The vehicle shall be registered from RTO
TDS shall be deducted from vehicle rent against each bill.

The vehicle available for rent shall be Tata Indigo/TATA Zest/ Verito/MaruthiSpresso/ Swift Dezire/Bolero/ ToyotoEtios vehicle Model not earlier than 2021 For the same supporting documents to be provided.
The number plate on the vehicle should be Yellow Board
The driver should have valid driving license
Conditional tender shall not be accepted
In case of vehicle repair or non availability of vehicles alternate arrangement of vehicle shall be made by the tenderer, failure of which amount will be deducted in the Bill
The driver shall adhere to the instruction from the officer all the time
In case of any kind of accidents if any damages happen, it will be the responsibility of the tenderer to get it repaired at his own cost.
If the behavior of the driver is not satisfactory to the officer, the driver shall be replaced
The Executive Engineer can accept or reject any of the tenders without any reason.
The agency should follow all relevant transport laws. Copy of RC Book, Driver license, vehicle insurance
Travel Agency/Person shall provide a suitable driver (non-alcoholic) to this office
The vehicle shall be maintained in good condition always and should be produced for spot inspection and trial at the time of opening of Tender Document
If the prices quoted by two or more tenders are same then the latest model vehicle will be selected
Vehicle should be in good condition for travel. He has to produce experience certificate having vehicle given for hiring base to State Government/semi Government
The Agency/Person shall provide a substitute in case of absence/leave of the driver
The driver shall maintain meticulously the details in the log-book and with sign by the officer in charge
All payments and bills shall be as per the relevant details in the log book
The Agency/Person shall ensure that the vehicle insurance and Road Tax papers should be in order and paid up to date
The driver shall come neatly dressed to work
The Agency/Person shall submit its bills once a month
Payment shall be as per Government rules issued from time to time
Opening of meter reading shall commence from office and closing the same at office only
The driver shall carry the driving Licenses and relevant documents while on duty
The Agency/Person shall take steps to ensure that the vehicle provided to office always conforms to the Emission norms prescribed as per law and rules in force
The Agency/Person shall bear all taxes, duties, levies and penalties

It shall be the sole responsibility of the Agency/Person of the cars to meet or discharge any liability arising out of the violation of Traffic Rules and Regulations and Statutory Regulations and all such rules in force
The driver shall carry the identity card together with an attested photocopy which in turn shall be attested by the Division office
The tender period is up to one year (12 months) from the date of agreement.
